column1: # W&B sync of the MN5 production runs (offline on the cluster: no outbound internet) to
# openeurollm-project/flag_hybrid. One line per run: <wandb run id>  <run dir on MN5 (glob)>.
# Every 3-day segment / restart of a run writes a new offline run (Megatron has no fixed run id);
# all fragments under the glob are uploaded into the one W&B run <id>, in order of start time.
# Ids: letters, digits, '-', '_'. Add a line per new main run (owners: the run's agent).
